question: What ritual sequence follows the worship of the five Lakṣmīs?
premises: The five Lakṣmīs are to be worshipped first
After that worship, another act is enjoined
The next act is worship of the five wish-granting cows
inference: After worshipping the five Lakṣmīs, one should worship the five wish-granting cows.
plain_english: Having worshipped the five Lakṣmīs, one should then worship the five wish-granting cows.
